title: Block unrepresentable dilution results before displaying reportable values
prompt:
Fix one arithmetic defect in lib/ohworks-dilution-rerun.ts. Lines 314-318 multiply the raw reading by its applied dilution without validating the product; line 327 similarly calculates an unchecked reportable lower bound. I reproduced report_as_is with correctedResult=Infinity using analyte SYNTH, unit mg/L, rawReading=1e308, appliedDilutionFactor=2, measuring range 0..1e308, ladder [2], maximum factor 2, and rerun tracking 0/2. The demo consumer at lib/ohworks-demo-analytical-run-view.ts:66-73 directly formats these values for users.

Check every derived reportable product before constructing a successful outcome. Return decision block with a precise local non-finite-result reason and null numeric outputs when multiplication is unrepresentable. Add the reason to this module's existing decision/message maps. Preserve finite calculations, rerun selection, threshold comparisons, and immutable output. Do not modify the demo consumer or introduce a shared helper.

Add tests/ohworks/dilution-result-overflow.test.ts covering corrected-result overflow, negative below-range overflow, greater-than-limit overflow, and a large representable control. Assert the decision, reason, and null outputs. Run node --import tsx --test tests/ohworks/dilution-rerun.test.ts tests/ohworks/dilution-result-overflow.test.ts tests/ohworks/demo-analytical-run-view.test.ts.

Planning verification reproduced the defect and passed the existing evaluator and demo-view tests. Change only the named production file and new test. Use fabricated data; no credentials, deployments, sends, payments, migrations, auth, package.json, or workflow changes. work on the assigned branch you are on.
